description.content:
Returns *Order* data. This will return order data immediately after an order is placed on the storefront.

> #### Note
> * Substitute your storefront domain for `yourstore.example.com`. 
> * The Send a Test Request feature is not currently supported for this endpoint.

query.description: Sub-resources to include in an Order, in a comma-separated list. The ID and the specified fields will be returned.

variable.description: Permanent ID of the BigCommerce store.
Permanent ID of the BigCommerce store.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey
